etsy.title: Custom Cheerleading Poster | Personalized Cheer Wall Art From Your Photos | Digital Download | Cheerleader Gift
etsy.description:
A poster of your athlete that looks like a real sports campaign, not a photo in a frame.

━━━━━━ WHAT YOU GET ━━━━━━

POSTER FILE ONLY
• Two shapes, so it fits the frame you already own:
  3:4 — prints 12x16, 15x20, 18x24 in
  2:3 — prints 12x18, 16x24, 20x30, 24x36 in
• Every size above is 300 DPI or better. Print at a local shop, online, or at home
• The artwork is composed for each shape — not one file cropped to fit

POSTER + SOCIAL + SCREENS adds
• Social files sized for a feed and for stories, not crops of the poster
• Phone, tablet and desktop wallpapers, with safe zones so nothing important sits under the clock or the dock

ALL SIX STYLES gives you the same athlete built in every one of our six art styles.

━━━━━━ HOW YOUR POSTER IS MADE — OUR 6-STEP PROCESS ━━━━━━

Your athlete is not a photo dropped into a template. We build a new image of them.

1 · PHOTO CHECK. We review the photos you send and tell you straight away if anything won't work.
2 · KIT BUILD. We reconstruct the uniform, club crest and colours for your sport.
3 · REFERENCE PLATE. We create and lock one reference of your athlete — face, build, hair, kit. Nothing else is generated until this is right, and you approve it before we go on.
4 · THE SHOTS. Every pose inherits that locked reference, so all of them are the same person.
5 · VERIFICATION. We measure the face match numerically and check every mark on the kit against the reference. A measurement, not an opinion.
6 · FINISH. The approved frames are composed into your poster, social files and wallpapers.

WHAT WE AIM FOR: that it is hard to tell whether you are looking at a photograph or a generated image. That is the standard we hold every frame to.

━━━━━━ HOW TO ORDER ━━━━━━

1. Choose your options above
2. Add your athlete's name, sport, jersey number and team in the personalisation box
3. Upload your photos
4. We send your reference plate for approval before anything else is made
5. Your files arrive through Etsy — no physical item ships

━━━━━━ PHOTOS THAT WORK BEST ━━━━━━

• 3 to 10 photos, the more the better
• High resolution — not blurry when you zoom in
• Face clearly visible, good light, no heavy filters
• At least one full-body photo, head to feet
• If possible, one in the team's kit
• Team crest or logo as a separate image if you have it

Blurry, dark or heavily filtered photos are the single biggest reason a likeness comes out weaker. We check them first and tell you before we start.

━━━━━━ SIX ART STYLES ━━━━━━

Stadium Night · Chrome All-Star · Fire & Smoke · Heritage · Signature Spotlight · Prism Rush

Each one is a different material and atmosphere, not a different layout. Tell us which you want in the personalisation box, or choose the all-six option and we build your athlete in every one.

━━━━━━ AI DISCLOSURE ━━━━━━

These images are created with AI image tools, directed by our own prompts and our own six-step process. Every frame is reviewed, corrected and approved by a human before anything is delivered. Results depend on the photos you send — clear, well-lit photos that show the athlete fully give the closest likeness.

━━━━━━ GOOD TO KNOW ━━━━━━

• We never reproduce real league or brand marks (NFL, FIFA, NCAA, Olympic, or sportswear logos). Your club's own crest, yes — a licensed league mark, never.
• 17 sports supported: basketball, football, baseball, softball, soccer, ice hockey, volleyball, lacrosse, wrestling, cheerleading, gymnastics, track & field, swimming, tennis, golf, pickleball, skateboarding.
• DIGITAL DELIVERY ONLY. No physical item ships with this listing.
• Your photos are used for your order only and are deleted on request.
etsy._type_note: INTENTIONALLY 'physical', not 'download'. Etsy instant-download attaches ONE file for every buyer, which cannot work for a per-athlete file. ScrapBits (73.6k sales) runs the same model: made-to-order, delivered by message, 'No physical item will be shipped'. CONFIRM the exact setting in Shop Manager before publishing — this is open question #2 in README.md.
etsy._taxonomy_note: Fill from getSellerTaxonomyNodes. Target: Art & Collectibles > Prints > Digital Prints.
etsy._shipping_note: Needs a $0 / no-ship profile since nothing physical moves.

questions.instructions: Example: Maya Rodriguez / Softball / 14 / Riverside Rays. Add the art style you want, and a short bio line or up to 3 stats if you'd like them on the card back.
3-10 photos. High resolution, face clearly visible, at least one full body. Add the club crest as a separate file if you have it.
questions._api_note: CANNOT BE CREATED VIA API. The Etsy spec allows only question_type 'text_input' today: "Currently, only a single question with type 'text_input' is supported." Add this question BY HAND in Shop Manager, once per listing. Verified live on a competitor listing (ArcadiusForge, 3 files; RingerCards allows 10).

inventory._note: Etsy allows a MAXIMUM OF 2 variation properties per listing, so the six art styles live in the personalisation text, not here.

_gate: DO NOT PUBLISH until the 2:3 poster template exists for all six finishes. The copy above promises two ratios (3:4 at 5400x7200 and 2:3 at 7200x10800); only 3:4 is built. Written ahead of the build on purpose, 2026-08-25 — the listing is a draft, so this is safe only while it stays a draft. Also outstanding: TRIM (no-bleed) exports exist for SN and CA only; FS/HE/SS/PR have PRINT-with-bleed exports, which a digital buyer must not receive.
